description: Queue a full battery or retry pending work off the action queue. The trigger is a terminal EDGE_SINK that submits durable work and returns immediately.
embedding_description: Queue a full battery or retry pending work off the action queue. Uses the shared platform-smoke-proof/v1 producer with immutable Git input identities and explicit evidence. Current and historical results disclose reuse, skips, failures, unknown inputs and delegated commissioning; no caller-provided shell command is executed.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Wrong immutable identity, unsafe paths, missing principal or stale expected_version are integrity failures. Unknown ancillary inputs produce advisories and disable unsafe reuse.
